newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to give small, medium firms tax advantages.
newsitem.headline: Spain to give small, medium firms tax advantages.

text.p: Spain's Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Monday the government wants to approve fiscal measures for small- and medium-sized firms aimed at boosting employment and investment.

He added that the government intends to cut income taxes to certain categories of small firms when they increase the number of workers and invest. The government will also allow a faster degree of asset revaluation and speed up the process of VAT reimbursement.
In December 1996, Spain cut to 30 percent the tax rate on the first 15 million pesetas profit in firms whose turnover is lower than 250 million pesetas. -- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
